name: footballcharts-mcp
display_name: Football Charts — football data for 93 leagues
description: Tables, results, fixtures, goal timing and season projections for 93 football leagues, lower divisions included. No key needed.
long_description:
Give Claude football data for **93 leagues in 42 countries** — top divisions, the lower tiers most sources skip (Spanish regional groups, Czech 2/3, Baltic, Nordic, Asian and African leagues) and women's leagues.

Ten read-only tools: league tables (classic, luck-adjusted, goals), results with half-time scores and first-goal minutes, upcoming fixtures with a public baseline model's probabilities, one-match detail, Monte Carlo season projections (title / top-4 / relegation, 10,000 runs, daily), team pages, goal timing per 15-minute bin, and the model's public calibration record (hit rate, Brier score, reliability).

**Works without an API key** (300 requests/day per IP). A free key from football-charts.com/developers lifts that to 5,000/day. Current and previous season per league; no bookmaker odds.

Statistics, not betting advice. Data by football-charts.com.

tools.name: about_football_charts
tools.description: Summary of the source: leagues covered, what it does not hold, league-key and season formats, how to read the probabilities.

tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: Every league covered (93 across 42 countries) with its key, country and seasons available.

tools.name: get_league_table
tools.description: Standings for one league season with form, expected points and a luck category; view=luck or goals for alternative rankings.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Finished matches of one league season with full-time and half-time scores and first-goal minute; filter by team, keep the latest N with last.

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: Upcoming matches of one league with the model's calibrated probabilities.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match in full, by slug: model probabilities, team ratings and goal-timing histograms.

tools.name: get_season_projection
tools.description: Title, top-four and bottom-three probabilities and points ranges from 10,000 simulations, refreshed daily.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: One team's season: table row, match log, goals per 15-minute period and first-goal distribution.

tools.name: get_goal_timing
tools.description: Goals per 15-minute period for every team in a league season, with peak periods and league totals; pass team for one team.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: The model's public calibration record: hit rate, Brier score and reliability buckets.

api_key.title: Football Charts API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to use the keyless tier (300 requests/day). A free key from https://www.football-charts.com/developers gives 5,000/day.
